html:
G'oya

Bitta CTE har bir bo'lim fondini hisoblaydi, ikkinchisi shu fondlarni qo'shib umumiy summani beradi. Umumiy summa bitta qator, uni CROSS JOIN bilan har bir bo'lim yoniga qo'yamiz va bo'lamiz.

Yechim

WITH dept AS (
  SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS fund
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(fund) AS all_fund FROM dept
)
SELECT d.department, d.fund, ROUND(100.0 * d.fund / t.all_fund, 2) AS pct
FROM dept d
CROSS JOIN total t

100.0 tasodifan yozilmagan. Kasrli son bo'linmani ham kasrli qiladi: IT bo'limi 31 000 / 55 500 dan 55.86 chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

100 deb butun son yozilsa, butun songa butun son bo'linadi va kasr qismi tashlab yuboriladi. Namunada IT 55.86 o'rniga 55, HR 15.32 o'rniga 15 oladi:

Noto'g'riWITH dept AS (
  SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS fund
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT department, fund,
       ROUND(100 * fund / (SELECT SUM(salary) FROM employees), 2) AS pct
FROM dept

Ulushni xodimlar soni bo'yicha hisoblash ham xato. Masala maosh fondini so'rayapti: uch kishilik bo'lim kam maosh olsa, uning ulushi kichik bo'ladi.

Dialektlar farqi

Yechimdagi 100.0 ni 100 ga almashtirsangiz, PostgreSQL'da natija baribir to'g'ri chiqadi. Sababi total CTE'sida: PostgreSQL INTEGER ning yig'indisini BIGINT, BIGINT ning yig'indisini esa NUMERIC qilib qaytaradi, all_fund kasrli bo'lib qoladi. SQLite'da hammasi butun son bo'lib qoladi. Bunga tayanmang: 100.0 ikkala bazada ham ishlaydi.

Boshqa yo'l

Oyna funksiyasi bilan bitta so'rovda: SUM(SUM(salary)) OVER () guruhlangan yig'indilarni yana bir marta, butun natija bo'yicha qo'shadi.

SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS fund,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(salary) / SUM(SUM(salary)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM employees
GROUP BY department
